goal: Qualify Alibaba Bailian Qwen3.8-Max through the existing bounded Provider probe and reviewed generation route.
acceptance_criteria: A live cgkn_probe_provider call reports connected while retaining formal evidence status NOT_EVALUATED.
An isolated minimal project is attempted through the reviewed Provider route and its supported tests are executed; any Provider or generation limitation is reported without formal PASS promotion.
Provider transport, plugin, kernel-contract, and management validations pass without adding a generation or delivery path.
The Qwen probe disables reasoning only for the bounded diagnostic request, consumes no more than 128 output Tokens, and does not expose or persist the API key in project artifacts or tool arguments.
The built-in Provider probe reaches qwen3.8-max through the existing Responses route with a provider-compatible output budget and a visible pong response.

quality_metrics.measure: management artifacts conform to registered JSON schemas and semantic invariants
quality_metrics.target: all management, iteration, and experience artifacts validate
quality_metrics.method: jsonschema tests plus deterministic manager validation

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: scripts/check_connectivity.py remains the single OpenAI-compatible endpoint and payload adapter used by the plugin probe.
Qwen-specific diagnostic defaults are scoped to Alibaba Model Studio qwen3.8 models and do not alter ordinary Provider generation payloads.
The existing reviewed Provider route, output validation, local_packager, and public delivery gate remain unchanged.

feedback: Qwen3.8-Max passed live Responses and structured leaf generation, but sustained multi-file generation was blocked by repeated Provider read timeouts before a complete candidate could be tested.

worked: Explicit single-model routing and identity-bound checkpoints allowed safe real-provider qualification without exposing credentials or materializing an incomplete candidate.
did_not_work: The current Provider read-timeout budget was insufficient for a backend leaf; repeated local fallback output did not satisfy the same contract.
experiments: Before another full run, qualify a longer per-leaf Provider timeout or a lower-latency Qwen deployment with the same checkpoint and contract gates.
